meals.name: Kefir & Blueberry Smoothie + Fried Eggs on Sourdough with Feta
meals.image_prompt: overhead photo of two fried eggs on toasted sourdough with crumbled feta, beside a tall glass of purple blueberry kefir smoothie, natural morning light, white plate on a linen cloth
day_of_steps: Pour 250 ml kefir into a blender, add 80 g blueberries and half a banana; blend until smooth and pour into a glass.
Toast 40 g sourdough bread (Diego) or 30 g sourdough (Diana) in the toaster.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat with a few drops of olive oil; crack eggs directly into the pan.
Fry eggs 2–3 min until whites are set but yolks still slightly runny; season with black pepper.
Slide eggs onto toast, crumble 30 g feta (Diego) or 20 g feta (Diana) on top.
Serve smoothie alongside. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Apple & Almonds
meals.image_prompt: a crisp green apple sliced on a wooden board beside a small bowl of raw almonds, natural side light, minimal styling
day_of_steps: Rinse and slice 1 apple (pomme); portion almonds into a small bowl.
Eat fibre-first: start with apple slices, then almonds. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Mediterranean Beef & Lentil Bowl with Roasted Bell Peppers & Quinoa
meals.image_prompt: overhead bowl of quinoa topped with braised beef chunks, green lentils, and roasted red bell pepper strips, drizzled with olive oil and dusted with paprika, natural light, rustic ceramic bowl
prep_steps: Sunday: braise beef chuck for the week (see prep_batch_2).
Sunday: cook quinoa for Mon–Wed (see prep_batch_4).
Sunday: roast bell peppers for Mon–Thu (see prep_batch_5).
Sunday: cook lentils for the week (see prep_batch_6).
day_of_steps: Reheat 150 g (Diego) or 110 g (Diana) braised beef in a saucepan with a splash of water over medium heat for 3–4 min.
Reheat 120 g (Diego) or 90 g (Diana) cooked quinoa in a separate pan or microwave (1 min) with a splash of water.
Reheat 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) roasted bell pepper strips in the same pan as beef for 1 min.
Reheat 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) cooked lentils in a small pot over low heat for 2 min.
Build the bowl: quinoa base, then lentils, beef, bell peppers.
Drizzle 2 tsp olive oil over bowl; season with smoked paprika and black pepper.
Serve with 1 orange (Diego) or ½ orange (Diana) on the side. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Greek Yogurt & Walnuts
meals.image_prompt: small ceramic bowl of thick white Greek yogurt topped with walnut halves, soft natural light, marble surface
day_of_steps: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl.
Top with walnuts. Eat slowly. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Soy-Ginger Baked Salmon with Stir-Fried Broccoli & Carrots on Sourdough
meals.image_prompt: a piece of glossy soy-ginger baked salmon fillet on toasted sourdough beside stir-fried broccoli florets and carrot batons glistening with sesame oil, overhead, natural light, dark plate
day_of_steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C. Line a baking tray with foil.
Mix 2 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp grated ginger (or ½ tsp ginger powder), 1 tsp sesame oil, and a squeeze of lime juice in a bowl.
Place salmon fillets on the tray, spoon marinade over each. Bake 14–16 min until flaky.
While salmon bakes, heat 1 tsp olive oil in a wok or large pan over high heat.
Add 120 g (Diego) or 90 g (Diana) broccoli florets and 60 g (Diego) or 45 g (Diana) carrot batons; stir-fry 5–6 min with a splash of soy sauce and black pepper.
Toast sourdough bread 40 g (Diego) or 30 g (Diana).
Plate: sourdough, salmon on top, stir-fried vegetables alongside. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Kefir & Apple Smoothie + Fried Eggs on Sourdough with Avocado-Style Olive Spread
meals.image_prompt: two fried eggs on golden sourdough toast spread with mashed avocado, next to a tall glass of pale green apple kefir smoothie, morning natural light, white ceramic plate
day_of_steps: Blend 250 ml kefir with 100 g chopped apple and a pinch of cinnamon until smooth; pour into a glass.
Toast sourdough: 40 g (Diego) or 30 g (Diana).
Fry 2 eggs per person in a lightly oiled non-stick pan over medium heat, 2–3 min; season with black pepper.
Mash ¼ of a ripe avocado (where available; or use 1 tsp olive oil + pinch of sea salt) — for this palette, drizzle 1 tsp olive oil and sprinkle sea salt onto toast instead.
Slide eggs onto toast, drizzle olive oil, season. Serve with smoothie. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Pear & Pistachios
meals.image_prompt: a ripe yellow pear sliced on a small board beside a handful of green pistachios in a bowl, soft daylight, minimal
day_of_steps: Rinse and slice 1 pear (poire). Portion pistachios.
Eat pear first (fibre), then pistachios. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Asian Beef Bowl with Stir-Fried Zucchini & Mushrooms on Brown Rice
meals.image_prompt: ceramic bowl of steamed brown rice topped with glazed soy-ginger beef strips, sautéed zucchini coins and sliced mushrooms, drizzled with sesame oil, overhead natural light
prep_steps: Sunday: braise beef chuck for the week (prep_batch_2) — portion for this dish on Tuesday.
Sunday: roast bell peppers and mushrooms (prep_batch_5) — mushrooms reheated here.
day_of_steps: Cook brown rice fresh: bring 180 ml water to boil, add 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) dry brown rice, cover, simmer 25 min — OR use a quick-cook pouch. (If time is tight, cook rice the night before and refrigerate — use within 1 day.)
Reheat 150 g (Diego) or 110 g (Diana) braised beef in a hot pan with 1 tbsp soy sauce and ½ tsp ginger powder for 2–3 min.
In the same pan, add 1 tsp sesame oil; toss in 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) sliced zucchini (courgette) and 60 g (Diego) or 45 g (Diana) pre-cooked mushrooms; stir-fry 3 min.
Reheat 60 g (Diego) or 45 g (Diana) cooked lentils separately in microwave 1 min.
Assemble bowl: rice base, lentils, beef, vegetables. Season with black pepper.
Serve with ½ banana on side. Drink 500 ml water.

day_of_steps: Spoon Greek yogurt into a bowl, top with walnuts. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: French-Style Tilapia en Papillote with Leeks, Cherry Tomatoes & Sourdough
meals.image_prompt: tilapia fillet baked in parchment paper, opened to reveal leek ribbons, halved cherry tomatoes, and herbs, served beside a slice of sourdough, top view, natural light, white surface
day_of_steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C. Cut two sheets of baking parchment.
Slice 80 g leeks (poireaux) into thin rings; halve 100 g cherry tomatoes (tomates cerises). Divide between sheets.
Place tilapia fillet on each sheet of vegetables. Drizzle with 1 tsp olive oil each, season with dried thyme, black pepper, and a squeeze of lime.
Fold parchment tightly to seal. Bake 18–20 min.
Toast sourdough 40 g (Diego) or 30 g (Diana) during last 3 min.
Open parcel carefully (steam!), plate fish and vegetables with juices over toast. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Mexican Beef & Chickpea Tacos with Roasted Bell Peppers
meals.image_prompt: two corn tortillas filled with spiced beef strips, golden chickpeas, roasted bell pepper strips, and mixed salad greens, overhead view, natural light, colourful rustic plate
prep_steps: Sunday: braise beef chuck for the week (prep_batch_2).
day_of_steps: Warm 2 corn tortillas (tortillas de maïs) per person in a dry pan 30 sec each side, or wrap in damp paper towel and microwave 30 sec.
Reheat 150 g (Diego) or 110 g (Diego) braised beef in a pan with 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp chili powder, salt; toss over high heat 2–3 min.
Reheat 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) roasted bell peppers in the same pan for 1 min.
Reheat 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) cooked chickpeas with ½ tsp smoked paprika in microwave 1 min.
Lay tortillas flat; add a handful of mixed salad greens first (fibre first!), then beef, chickpeas, peppers.
Drizzle with 1 tsp lime juice and a spoon of Greek yogurt as sauce. Serve with ½ orange on the side. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Kefir & Pear Smoothie
meals.image_prompt: tall glass of creamy pale yellow kefir and pear smoothie, natural side light, clean white background, a halved pear beside the glass
day_of_steps: Blend 150 ml kefir with 1 chopped pear until smooth. Pour and drink. Drink 500 ml water alongside.

meals.name: Baked Salmon with Turmeric-Roasted Carrots & Spinach on Quinoa
meals.image_prompt: overhead plate of fluffy quinoa topped with a golden baked salmon fillet, turmeric-roasted orange carrot pieces, and wilted dark spinach, drizzled with olive oil, natural warm light
day_of_steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C. Toss 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) carrot batons with 1 tsp olive oil, ½ tsp turmeric, pinch of black pepper; spread on baking tray.
Place salmon fillet alongside carrots; season with dried oregano, sea salt, and a drizzle of olive oil.
Roast everything 18–20 min until salmon flakes and carrots are tender.
Meanwhile, microwave or briefly reheat pre-cooked quinoa (120 g Diego / 90 g Diana — from Sunday batch) with 2 tbsp water for 1 min.
Wilt 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) fresh spinach in a pan with 1 tsp olive oil and a grated garlic clove, 2 min.
Plate: quinoa, spinach, roasted carrots, salmon on top. Drizzle remaining olive oil. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Kefir & Orange Smoothie + Fried Eggs on Sourdough with Feta
meals.image_prompt: two fried eggs on toasted sourdough with crumbled white feta, beside a tall glass of bright orange kefir smoothie, morning natural light, linen napkin, overhead angle
day_of_steps: Squeeze juice of 1 orange (jus d'orange) or blend segments into 250 ml kefir; mix or blend until smooth.
Toast sourdough 40 g (Diego) or 30 g (Diana).
Fry 2 eggs per person in a lightly oiled non-stick pan 2–3 min; season with black pepper.
Slide onto toast, crumble 30 g feta (Diego) or 20 g feta (Diana). Serve with smoothie. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Mediterranean Tilapia & White Bean Bowl with Roasted Zucchini & Sweet Potato
meals.image_prompt: ceramic bowl with roasted sweet potato cubes, white beans, pan-seared tilapia chunks, and roasted zucchini coins, drizzled with olive oil and smoked paprika, natural overhead light
day_of_steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C. Cube 100 g (Diego) or 80 g (Diana) sweet potato (patate douce); toss with 1 tsp olive oil, ½ tsp smoked paprika; roast 20 min.
Meanwhile, slice 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) zucchini into coins; sauté in 1 tsp olive oil with garlic powder and dried oregano for 4–5 min.
Pat tilapia fillets dry; season with cumin, black pepper, sea salt. Pan-fry in 1 tsp olive oil over medium-high heat 3 min per side until golden.
Rinse and drain canned white beans (haricots blancs); warm in a small pan with 1 tsp olive oil, smoked paprika, and a splash of water for 2 min.
Build bowl: sweet potato, white beans, zucchini, tilapia on top. Drizzle with balsamic vinegar. Serve with ½ banana on side. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: French Leek & Mushroom Egg Frittata with Sourdough & Mixed Greens
meals.image_prompt: golden baked frittata with leeks and mushrooms in a cast iron skillet, sliced wedges served on plates with mixed salad greens and sourdough, warm natural light, overhead
day_of_steps: Preheat oven to 190 °C. Slice 80 g leeks and 80 g mushrooms (champignons).
Sauté leeks and mushrooms in 1 tsp olive oil in an oven-safe pan over medium heat 4 min; season with dried thyme and black pepper.
Beat 3 eggs (Diego) or 2 eggs (Diana) with 2 tbsp Greek yogurt, sea salt, and 30 g (Diego) / 20 g (Diana) crumbled feta.
Pour egg mixture over the vegetables in pan; cook on hob 2 min until edges set.
Transfer pan to oven; bake 8–10 min until fully set and golden on top.
Toast sourdough 40 g (Diego) / 30 g (Diana).
Serve frittata wedge(s) with mixed salad greens (tossed with 1 tsp balsamic vinegar) and toast alongside. Drink 500 ml water.

Toast sourdough 40 g (Diego) or 30 g (Diana).
Fry 2 eggs per person in lightly oiled pan 2–3 min; season with black pepper and sea salt.
Slide eggs onto toast; crumble 30 g feta (Diego) or 20 g feta (Diana) on top. Serve with smoothie. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Asian Tilapia & Chickpea Bowl with Stir-Fried Spinach & Potatoes
meals.image_prompt: rustic bowl with golden pan-seared tilapia, chickpeas, wilted spinach, and diced boiled potato, drizzled with soy-sesame sauce, overhead natural light, dark ceramic bowl
day_of_steps: Boil 120 g (Diego) or 90 g (Diana) diced potatoes (pommes de terre) with skin in salted water for 15 min; drain.
Meanwhile, pat tilapia dry; season with ginger powder and black pepper; pan-fry in 1 tsp sesame oil over medium-high heat 3 min per side.
In a wok, heat 1 tsp olive oil; add 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) fresh spinach, toss with 1 tsp soy sauce until wilted, 2 min.
Rinse 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) canned chickpeas; warm in pan with ½ tsp cumin and 1 tsp soy sauce for 2 min.
Build bowl: potatoes, spinach, chickpeas, tilapia on top. Drizzle with sesame oil. Serve with 1 apple on side. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Mexican-Spiced Beef & Lentil Stuffed Bell Peppers with Mixed Greens
meals.image_prompt: two roasted bell pepper halves stuffed with spiced beef and lentil filling, topped with crumbled feta, served alongside mixed salad greens on a white plate, overhead natural light
day_of_steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C. Halve 2 bell peppers (poivrons) and remove seeds; place cut-side up on baking tray.
In a pan, brown 150 g (Diego) or 110 g (Diana) lean ground beef (bœuf haché) — or slice fresh beef — with 1 tsp olive oil, 1 tsp cumin, ½ tsp chili powder, garlic powder, and black pepper, 5 min.
Add 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) drained canned lentils; stir and cook 2 more min. Add 1 tbsp tomato paste and 2 tbsp water; simmer 1 min.
Spoon beef-lentil mix into pepper halves; crumble 20 g feta over each portion. Bake 15–18 min until peppers are tender.
Dress mixed greens 50 g with 1 tsp balsamic vinegar and 1 tsp olive oil. Serve alongside stuffed peppers. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: French Salmon Niçoise-Style Bowl with Potatoes, Carrots & Lentils
meals.image_prompt: large bowl with flaked baked salmon, halved cherry tomatoes, boiled potato cubes, steamed carrot slices, green lentils and mixed greens, dressed with Dijon mustard vinaigrette, overhead natural light
day_of_steps: Boil 120 g (Diego) or 90 g (Diana) diced potatoes in salted water 12 min; drain.
Steam 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) carrot coins alongside potatoes if possible, or in a separate small pan for 8 min.
Bake salmon fillets at 200 °C for 14–16 min with olive oil, sea salt, and dried rosemary; or pan-fry 3 min per side.
Make Dijon dressing: whisk 1 tsp Dijon mustard, 1 tsp balsamic vinegar, 1 tsp olive oil, pinch of sea salt.
In a large bowl, place mixed greens, potatoes, carrots, lentils 80 g (Diego) / 60 g (Diana) drained, halved cherry tomatoes 80 g.
Flake salmon on top; drizzle dressing over all. Serve with ½ orange on side. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Mediterranean Beef & White Bean Stew with Roasted Zucchini & Sourdough
meals.image_prompt: deep bowl of rich tomato-based beef and white bean stew with chunks of tender beef, white beans, and roasted zucchini, served with a slice of sourdough, warm overhead light, rustic bowl
day_of_steps: Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat. Add 150 g (Diego) or 110 g (Diana) diced beef; brown all sides 4–5 min.
Add 1 clove minced garlic, ½ tsp dried oregano, ½ tsp smoked paprika, 1 tbsp tomato paste; stir and cook 1 min.
Add 100 ml water; simmer covered on low heat 15 min until beef is tender.
Add 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) drained canned white beans; cook uncovered 3 min.
Meanwhile, slice 80 g zucchini; sauté in 1 tsp olive oil in a separate pan 4 min, season with black pepper.
Toast sourdough 40 g (Diego) or 30 g (Diana).
Serve stew in bowls with zucchini on top and sourdough alongside. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Asian Salmon & Lentil Bowl with Stir-Fried Bell Peppers & Brown Rice
meals.image_prompt: bowl with steamed brown rice, glazed salmon cubes, green lentils and stir-fried rainbow bell pepper strips, drizzled with soy-sesame glaze, overhead natural light, dark ceramic bowl
day_of_steps: Cook brown rice: bring 180 ml (Diego) or 130 ml (Diana) water to boil; add 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) dry brown rice; cover, simmer 25 min.
While rice cooks, cut salmon into 3 cm cubes; marinate in 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tsp sesame oil, ½ tsp ginger powder for 5 min.
Slice 100 g bell peppers into strips; stir-fry in 1 tsp sesame oil over high heat 3–4 min.
Pan-fry marinated salmon cubes in a non-stick pan over medium-high heat 2 min per side.
Warm 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) canned lentils in microwave 1 min.
Build bowl: rice, lentils, stir-fried peppers, salmon on top. Drizzle remaining marinade over. Serve with ½ banana on side. Drink 500 ml water.

meals.name: Mediterranean Tilapia & Chickpea Traybake with Roasted Cherry Tomatoes, Leeks & Sourdough
meals.image_prompt: one-pan roasted tilapia fillet over golden chickpeas, halved roasted cherry tomatoes and leek rings, drizzled with olive oil, served with sourdough, overhead natural light, white ceramic dish
day_of_steps: Preheat oven to 200 °C. Slice 80 g leeks into rings; halve 100 g cherry tomatoes; drain 80 g (Diego) or 60 g (Diana) canned chickpeas.
Spread leeks, cherry tomatoes, and chickpeas in a baking dish; drizzle with 1 tsp olive oil, season with dried rosemary and black pepper; toss.
Nestle tilapia fillets on top of vegetables; drizzle fillets with 1 tsp olive oil, ½ tsp smoked paprika, and a squeeze of lime juice.
Roast 18–20 min until tilapia is flaky and vegetables are tender.
Toast sourdough 40 g (Diego) or 30 g (Diana) during last 3 min.
Serve traybake with sourdough on the side. Drizzle balsamic vinegar over vegetables. Drink 500 ml water.
